about: ws-options-verify --render capacity pins (tests/lib/options-render.cjs capacityPin). A value listed here may print fewer items on its fullest page than the default page because the OWNER has ruled on that cost; it is reported as debt, not a FAIL. Only the capacity comparison is pinned. Each entry cites its ruling. Remove an entry when the ruling changes.

divForm.why: owner ruling (Lane D restart, 2026-10-31; lead ruling 2026-11-03, Lane D R4 prep): the written form is the owner's notation choice and he accepted notation-driven capacity changes; the long-division bracket stays at 10 columns (owner). Measured: S vertical 25 vs 30; L long / fraction / mix 15 vs 16, vertical 12 vs 16
